name: ReinforcedAverageStrategy EMA8/21 with closed48h SMA50

source.author: Gert Wohlgemuth
source.asset_selection: BTCUSDT spot is predeclared researcher instance; author file does not specify a universe

framework_reference.name: Freqtrade
framework_reference.purpose: Fixed class defaults and qtpylib/technical reference semantics only; original author environment/external config unknown; not full Freqtrade engine.

signals.entry: EMA8[t]>EMA21[t] and EMA8[t-1]<=EMA21[t-1] and close[t]>closed48h_SMA50[t] and volume[t]>0
signals.resample: technical1.5.3 pandas resample2880min labelleft originstart_day; openfirst/highmax/lowmin/closelast/volumesum, source dropna; fixed raw grid starts2022-12-01T00UTC
signals.merge: higher interval open plus48h minus4h -> last constituent4h open; higher closed value usable after that native bar closes; forward-fill previously available values only, no backfill
signals.nan_policy: EMA first8/21 SMA seeds; higherSMA50 first validnativeindex599; first413 evaluation bars have no SMA filter and cannot enter; keep fixed evaluation start, no future fill or prehistory extension
signals.warmup: 186 bars before evaluation; insufficient for50x48h SMA; partial beginning not fabricated; fixed input contains381 full48h groups
signals.collision: Generic engine suppresses entry+exit collision; these two opposite crossovers cannot both hold; ROI/stop remain active
signals.availability: closed native4h signals only; no warmup trading or pending warmup order

risk.roi_slippage: fee-inclusive threshold before adverse2bps sell slip; exact threshold fill net49.97%
risk.stop_threshold_formula: entry_fill*0.8; fees and sell slip add to nominal20% price decline
risk.minute_roi_transition: None: constant0minute50% threshold, no intra-bar expiry approximation required

execution.known_halt_handling: 2023-03-24 11:27–14:00 UTC. Nominal 12:00 4h open is modeled at 14:00 using matching 1h resumption open; not tick proof. No orders assigned inside known halt. No all-history downtime/PIT claim.
execution.fill: full fractional quantity; raw actual open for scheduled trades, threshold or raw open for risk exits; adverse slip each side
sequence: due closed-bar exit signal AND NOT entry signal at executable open
flat entry signal AND NOT exit signal at executable open; never reenter after exit same bar
Resolve constant ROI50% threshold; stop and ROI active independently of signal state
existing/new position opening gap: stop if open<=stop, else ROI if open>=ROI
otherwise within-bar low stop check before high ROI check
mark remaining quantity at raw raw close; generate no warmup orders
execution.ambiguity: When open is between thresholds and both low/high touch risk levels, stop first; unknown 4h intrabar path, no subbar replay
execution.gap: scheduled exit still has open priority; risk gap fills at raw open plus adverse sell slip; gap crossing ROI is evaluated before subsequent intrabar low
execution.terminal: no forced liquidation; open position marked at final raw close, unpaid hypothetical exit costs not deducted
execution.pending: signal from evaluation-close only; arrives after configured number of bars; stale buy while long or exit while flat ignored; no execution beyond evaluation end
execution.limits: historical lot/min-notional limits, book liquidity, queueing, partial fills, funding and borrow not modeled

input.data_profile: NATIVE12_CANONICAL_DIAGNOSTIC_V1, explicit spot handoff; not canonical perpetual research bundle
input.provider_clock_newer_current_bucket: Not re-requested; predecessor HTTP451 respected; no bypass; strict finality still not established
input.pit_status: not proven: current retrospective archives, no contemporaneous snapshots or author universe
input.input_use: Offline reuse and raw-to-canonical revalidation of existing authorized snapshot;0 new market requests

evaluation.initial_state: all cash, no warmup signal carried to first evaluation open; first strategy entry possible at second evaluation open

metrics.sharpe: UTC end-of-day equity returns including initial equity, sample standard deviation ddof=1, sqrt(365), risk-free zero
metrics.max_drawdown: maximum decline from running peak over initial capital plus all unsampled 4h bar-close equities; no intrabar equity drawdown claim
metrics.daily_curve: last 4h close of each UTC date; timestamp is close boundary, e.g. 2025-01-01T00Z represents 2024-12-31 end-of-day
metrics.position_bar_fraction: fraction of evaluated bar-close states with quantity>0, not elapsed-time exact exposure

buyhold: 95% inclusive cash budget at first evaluation raw open, same fees/slip and terminal mark, no ROI/stop/exit signal
